subject: music
title: Tempo, Timbre & Texture
welcome_lead: Speed, sound colour and how parts stack together.
meta_desc: KS3 elements: tempo, timbre and texture explained.
final_note: Three more building blocks for any music.

walkthroughs.body_html: Tempo is measured in beats per minute (BPM). A walking pace is around 80-100 BPM. Pop songs sit around 120 BPM. A waltz is closer to 60.
Timbre (say 'tam-ber') is the unique sound colour of an instrument. A flute and a violin play the same note but sound completely different — that's timbre.
Monophonic texture = single line (one voice singing alone). Polyphonic = many lines together. Homophonic = melody with chord backing — like most pop songs.
